text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert -> High 5xx and gateway timeouts for /v1/generate (elevated across multiple POPs). Notifying @oncall-kai.

oncall-kai: on it. I see p95 errors jump and a lot of 5xx spikes from the edge dashboards. Can someone grab envoy upstream stats?

sre-liz: pulling logs now. Access logs show influx of 503/524 from upstream clusters around T-18m. Also seeing many envoys reporting 'upstream request retried' counters increasing dramatically.

eng-runtime-jordan: we rolled a new route policy to add retries and stricter circuit-breaker caps in the last deployment window (canary to prod). Could be related.

traffic-ops-maria: here's the sanitized route config we pushed: 
```
path: /v1/generate
retry_policy:
  retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure,reset"
  num_retries: 4
  per_try_timeout_ms: 1000
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    max_connections: 100
    max_pending_requests: 20
    max_requests: 300
```

oncall-kai: those pending limits look low given traffic burst. With retries=4 we could easily create retry storms if upstream slows.

sre-liz: confirmed: pending_requests at upstream proxies hit the cap and started rejecting, which caused the proxy to trigger retries, which fed more load back upstream. Classic retry storm / backpressure loop.

oncall-kai: immediate mitigation: 1) disable retries at edge for /v1/generate; 2) raise pending request and connection thresholds; 3) pause automated rollout. Who can push config?

eng-runtime-jordan: pushing a config patch to set num_retries=0 and remove retry_on for that route. Also bumping max_pending_requests to 200 and max_connections to 600 as a short-term hotfix. Starting rollout now.

deploy-bot: roll started: cfg-hotfix-4920000000 by eng-runtime-jordan -> 3 regions.

customer-success-ana: quick heads-up: CS shows several customers seeing errors (acct-1042, acct-558). I'll prepare a status note and tag the RU team.

sre-liz: after first region patched, 5xx rate dropped ~70% within 30s. After global patch, errors down to ~1.5% from peak ~22%. System p95 latency trending back.

oncall-kai: excellent. Now let's lock down the offending rollout: traffic-ops, please revert the rollout config and disable automatic route rollouts until we have gating.

traffic-ops-maria: rollback of rollout automation applied and diff saved to S3 (s3://redwood-ops/incidents/4920000000/diff.json). I also exported the failing metric windows.

eng-runtime-jordan: follow-ups I'm logging: add per-route retry budget (global rate cap for retries), add canary checks for pending_requests before enabling retries, add an alert when retry_count > X per minute. Will open RFC for safer defaults.

deploy-bot: roll succeeded: cfg-hotfix-4920000000. Changes live.

sre-liz: monitoring note: look at the new "retry_to_success_ratio" we're going to add. Right now success on retried requests is <5%, meaning retries mostly just amplified load.

oncall-kai: creating ticket SRE-14321 to cover: CB tuning, safe retry canary, automated rollback triggers, and postmortem. Assigning to eng-runtime and traffic-ops.

customer-success-ana: sent interim message to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated errors on generation endpoints and have applied mitigation. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for full remediation."

eng-runtime-jordan: adding a quick runbook snippet for emergency rollback of retries to the runbooks repo:
```
# emergency disable retries for route
PATCH /config/routes/v1/generate
payload: {"retry_policy": {"num_retries": 0, "retry_on": ""}}
# bump CBs if needed
PATCH /config/routes/v1/generate
payload: {"circuit_breakers": {"thresholds": {"max_pending_requests": 200, "max_connections": 600}}}
# verify with metrics
curl https://monitoring/api/query?expr=rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx[1m])
```

sre-liz: root cause summary for postmortem: A configuration rollout enabled aggressive retry behavior without sufficient circuit-breaker headroom or retry budgeting. Under elevated upstream latency, this created retry amplification and pending queue saturation, causing widespread 5xx.

oncall-kai: monitoring window: we'll keep this page open and watch for 45 minutes. If stable, we'll close. Good triage/coordination. :thumbsup: 

customer-success-ana: final note posted to customers at 15:24 UTC. I'll follow up with impact summary once the postmortem is ready.

traffic-ops-maria: saved full envoy dumps and metrics to incident bucket for postmortem analysis (s3://redwood-ops/incidents/4920000000/).

eng-runtime-jordan: next steps: implement retry budget, add canary gating based on pending_requests, and automate rollback if retry amplification threshold exceeded. I'll submit PRs today.

incident-bot: SEV2 -> downgraded to monitoring after metrics stabilized.

oncall-kai: closing the on-call page, will re-open if we see a regression. Nice work everyone.
